ACCESSORIES
iPad® Holder Front Screen Shade Seat Back Stowage
VPLVS0165 VPLFY0068 Premium – VPLVS0182
iPad® 1 Holder Reflects the suns rays and helps to keep the interior of your vehicle cool. Manufactured from the finest materials with soft touch interior lining and
VPLVS0164 magnetic button clasps, this convenient stowage system for the rear of the
front seats provides multiple compartments for stowing small items.
Standard – VPLVS0181 (not shown)
Ski Bag Universal Lift and Load System Rechargeable Flashlight
VPLGS0166 VPLVR0096 VPLAV0102
Carries up to two pairs of skis and poles up to 5.10 feet long. Features removable This roof loading aid fixes to your garage roof and allows you to lift equipment on High power 300 Lumen rechargeable flashlight machined from solid aluminum
shoulder straps. to the vehicle with ease. It can also be used for storing the roof box conveniently with a black anodised finish. An integral charging dock in the loadspace ensures
when removed from the vehicle. it is always charged and ready for action. Features maximum output with three
further settings including a flashing mode. Land Rover branded.
iPad® is a registered trademark of Apple Inc., registered in the US and other countries.
